product_summary: Website chiragelectronics.com (Ahmedabad, Gujarat; est. 1991; +91-79-22136323; info@chiragelectronics.com) describes the firm as an authorised DEALER/DISTRIBUTOR of industrial electronics brands: Phoenix Contact, Rexnord, Meanwell, Lapp India, Omron, Elcom, PLA, Essen. Concrete product lines named on the homepage: Meanwell LRS enclosed power supplies, MDR/HDR/EDR/NDR/TDR DIN-rail power supplies, LED drivers; plus 'active and passive components' for industrial, power and defence sectors. No medical devices, ECG or electrotherapy equipment are listed anywhere on the site.
comment: HS mismatch, but per project rule 3 the company is KEPT and the code corrected - no rejection. Declared 9018.11 (electro-cardiographs) and 9019.10 (mechano-therapy/psychological aptitude-testing apparatus) are medical-device codes and are NOT corroborated by any product on the company's own website: the site shows zero medical equipment. The declared codes look like a copy-paste from a medical-device supplier profile and are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Actual business is distribution of industrial automation and power-conversion components, which maps to 8504.40 (static converters / Meanwell power supplies and LED drivers), 8536.49 / 8536.69 / 8536.41 (Phoenix Contact and Omron relays, terminals, connectors), 8537.10 (control panels/PLC-type control units), 8541.40 (LED modules), 8532.24 / 8533.21 (passive components - capacitors, resistors), 8544.42 (Lapp India cables with connectors), 8483.40 (Rexnord gearboxes/couplings), 8539.52 (LED light sources). Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is also a misclassification: the site targets industrial, power and defence electronics, not oil/gas or chemicals. Trader signs are explicit - the company self-describes as 'authorised dealers'/'major distributor in India' of third-party brands (Meanwell, Phoenix Contact, Omron, Lapp, Rexnord, Elcom, PLA, Essen), i.e. reseller, not manufacturer. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: power supplies, LED drivers, relays, connectors/terminal blocks, cables, gearboxes/couplings, passive components. Note: the site claims 'Export Countries' in its achievements counter but gives no country, buyer or shipment record - that claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No customs line was available to me in this task, so no HS code here is confirmed by a customs record; all codes are derived from the website's product listing only. Legal-entity details (CIN/PAN) were not researched per task scope and are null.
